templates/text-to-image.num_inference_steps: The SD 1.5 baseline fixes 25 steps: it is the smallest, fastest reference template, kept stable to prove the engine works.
templates/text-to-image.guidance_scale: The SD 1.5 baseline runs at the pipeline's default guidance: it is the smallest, fastest reference template, kept stable to prove the engine works.

models/minimax-h3-image.num_images_per_prompt: MiniMax-H3-Image makes one image per run.
models/minimax-h3-image.num_inference_steps: MiniMax-H3-Image runs a fixed 6-step sampler with no step count.
models/minimax-h3-image.guidance_scale: MiniMax-H3-Image takes no guidance or negative prompt.

models/qwen-image-2.1.guidance_scale: Qwen-Image-2.1's pipeline takes no guidance_scale, only true_cfg_scale, which the vendor recommends leaving at its default of 1.0 (off).

text_to_image.models/flux-dev: FLUX.1 dev is gated and has no measured cost; Z-Image Turbo covers the standard tier in nine steps.
text_to_image.models/flux-dev-compile: A torch.compile variant of models/flux-dev for CUDA, not a separate rung: the compile is skipped on MPS.
text_to_image.models/flux-gguf: Takes only prompt and seed (no width or height) and needs a GGUF checkpoint_path supplied.
text_to_image.models/flux-krea: A FLUX.1 Krea dev aesthetic variant with no measured cost; Z-Image Turbo covers photographic output in the standard tier.
text_to_image.models/flux-torchao: Takes only prompt and seed (no width or height), and is unmeasured: the int8 variant ran at over a minute per denoising step on an RTX 3090.
text_to_image.models/flux2-dev: Has no width or height variable, so it fails the contract.
text_to_image.models/flux3-klein: Klein turns a short prompt into a generic picture, and its only ladder route, templates/flux3/upsample-then-generate, takes 'request', not 'prompt'. Revisit after the mps bench (#1625 Q3).
text_to_image.models/krea2: Takes only prompt and seed (no width or height), so it fails the contract.
